lines: (Something long and dark is curled around the hollow log. Lots and lots of legs. A pale face turns slowly to look at {player}.)
Oh! A visitor? Nobody ever visits.
I know. Everybody runs away before I can even say hello.
It's the legs, I think. I've got rather a lot of them. I'm working on it.
{player}. That's a lovely name.
I don't have a name. Nobody's ever stayed long enough to ask.
Sometimes I creep to the edge of town to look at the lights. And sometimes I hide behind the walls at the school, just to hear people laughing.
But when they see me, they scream. So I hide.
I'm not trying to be scary. I just... wanted a friend.
(All of the centipede's legs wiggle at once. {player} thinks that means happy.)
A friend! I've never had one of those before!

choice.text: Being scared of you wasn't fair. I'm sorry.
lines: (The centipede blinks. Slowly, it smiles.)
Thank you. Nobody's ever said sorry to me before.
{player}... would you give me a name? I think a friend should have a name.

choice.name: Wiggles
lines: Wiggles. WIGGLES! (All the legs wiggle.) It fits!

choice.name: Shelby
lines: Shelby. Shelby the centipede. That sounds like someone people would want to meet.

choice.name: Sir Legs-a-Lot
lines: SIR Legs-a-Lot? (The centipede sits up very straight.) I'm a knight now. A very leggy knight.
You came back! Most people only come once. If they come at all.
(All of the centipede's legs wiggle at once.)
A friend! A real one!

choice.text: I just wanted to see you again.
lines: That's... that's the nicest thing anyone's ever said to me.

rotate: Did you know there are thirty-seven kinds of mushroom in here? I've named every one.
I counted the glow-bugs last night. I got to a hundred, then forgot where I was. So I started again. It was lovely.
Being scary is lonely. Being friends is much better.
Thank you for not running away, {player}.
If you ever feel scared in here, it's okay to go home. The gate's always there.
I'll still be here when you come back.
